description: Product catalog. One row per SKU (stock keeping unit). Contains pricing, category, and inventory data.
use_cases: Joining to order_items to compute revenue per product

columns.product_id: Primary key — unique identifier for each product (INTEGER or UUID)
columns.name: Product name (TEXT, e.g. 'Wireless Headphones Pro')
columns.price: Current unit price in USD (NUMERIC, e.g. 29.99)
columns.created_at: Timestamp when the product was added to the catalog (TIMESTAMPTZ)

sample_questions: What are the top 5 best-selling products by revenue?
Which products have less than 10 units in stock?
What is the average price by category?
